$comment: Copy this to roots.json. It says where THIS machine keeps its project
folders, so the committed registry can use ${ROOST}/Forge instead of a
path that is only true on one laptop. Ifreglen's own apps live under
${SHELL}/apps, which is this desktop folder and needs no entry.
Not a secret — tokens go in secrets.json, which is a different file for a
reason (see lib/roots.js). ROOST, SHELL and HOME always exist; on
Windows ROOST defaults to C: and on anything else to ~/projects, so a
machine that keeps its projects where the defaults say needs no file here
Forward slashes are fine on Windows: path.resolve normalises them.
